title: json: further optimize JSON output (6.6x total speedup)
description:
Continue work after !25374

- Add json_dumper_value_string_noesc for hex strings (skip escape scan)
- Last-hit data source cache eliminates linear search per field
- Use stack buffer for hex string conversion (avoid malloc per field)

Measured with `-T json -x --no-duplicate-keys` on 1000-packet NGAP capture:

* Before: 31.0s
* After: 4.7s (6.6x faster, up from 5x in previous commit)

Output is byte-for-byte identical.

AI-Assisted: yes (Kiro)

Ping @martin.r.mathieson 

PERF PROFILE — ngap_1000p.pcapng | 4.7s | 6.6x faster than reference (31s)

```
 5.71%  __vfprintf_internal          (remaining printf formatting)
 5.50%  _int_free                    (memory frees)
 5.20%  malloc                       (memory allocations)
 4.39%  json_puts_string             (JSON string escaping)
 3.48%  ws_label_strcpy              (field label formatting)
 3.45%  _IO_default_xsputn          (fwrite from buffer flush)
 3.38%  __memmove_evex_unaligned_erms (memcpy)
 3.34%  jd_putc                      (buffered char output)
 3.33%  jd_buf_append                (buffered string output)
 3.00%  _int_malloc                  (malloc internals)
 2.81%  g_str_hash                   (hash table operations)
 2.33%  __strlen_evex                (string length)
 2.07%  proto_node_group_children_by_json_key
 1.82%  proto_tree_add_node
 1.78%  __strchrnul_evex
 1.63%  cfree
 1.57%  prepare_token
 1.39%  write_json_proto_node_list
 1.15%  g_hash_table_lookup
 1.02%  wmem_block_fast_alloc
 1.01%  print_newline_indent

 0.82%  json_write_field_hex_value   ← was 10.9%, now <1%

```

The profile is now completely flat — no single function above 6%. The write_json_proto_node_hex_dump and json_write_field_hex_value that were dominating at 12% and 11% are now gone (0.82%). The last-hit cache eliminated the linear data source scan entirely.
